Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players of West Indies are out in the middle. Andy Balbirnie and William Porterfield will open the batting for Ireland. Jason Holder will start with the ball.
...THE RUN CHASE...

Right then! Ireland need 270 runs to win the first ODI of the series! The pitch seems to have eased out a bit and the tourists have a good chance to draw first blood here! Will the Irish batters put on a show and help their side start off on a winning note? We'll find that shortly. Do join us for the chase.

Shamarh Brooks is up for a quick chat. He says that it feels very good to perform on his debut game but is gutted to miss out on a hundred on debut. Adds that they were struggling at the start but he had a good partnership with Kieron Pollard. Tells that his partnership with the skipper was very crucial. Mentions that they have a decent score on the board and their bowlers will need to get some early wickets for them now.

West Indies began their innings in a comprehensive manner but it went downhill from there. They lost wickets in quick succession and were in a spot of bother. But, Kieron Pollard and Shamarh Brooks did some damage control and rebuilt the innings. They stitched 155 runs together and guided West Indies to a healthy total of 269. Brooks had an amazing debut but he would be disappointed after missing out on his maiden century by just 7 runs. Pollard too, played a fine knock of 69. He started off slowly and switched gears at the right time. An entertaining first half of the game, it's now upto to the bowlers of West Indies.

Ireland got the desired start, they took wickets in a cluster at the beginning and put West Indies under pressure early in the innings. But, they leaked out runs and lost the way in the middle. After breaking the partnership between Pollard and Brooks, they got back in the game by picking up quick wickets at the death and restricted West Indies to 269. Mark Adair was the pick of the bowler, he was economical and grabbed three vital wickets for his side. Ireland now need 270 runs to clinch the first game, but they are up against a fiery West Indies bowling attack.

A great recovery from the hosts and a fine batting display! At one point 220 was looking far-fetched but they have done well to put a handy total of 269 on the board, courtesy of a fine partnership by Kieron Pollard and Shamarh Brooks. Ireland would not be completely satisfied with their performance after an exceptional start.

OUT! TAKEN! Odean Smith goes for another biggie but holes out this time! Adair bangs it into the deck, around middle. Smith backs away and looks to pull hard but it goes off the top edge and high in the air towards deep square leg. Gareth Delany there settles under it and takes a simple catch. West Indies are bowled out for 269.
Commentary.Howout: c Gareth Delany b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Brute force from Smith! A low full toss, around off. Smith drills it straight back past the bowler and collects a boundary.
SIX! WHACKED! A low full toss, around middle. Smith hangs back and sends it sailing way over the long on fence to fetch himself a biggie.
Good-length ball, around off. Hosein taps it to backward point and takes off for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Odean Smith drills it towards long off for a single.

FOUR! Edged and it goes just wide of the keeper! Back of a length, outside off. Akeal Hosein throws his bat at it but gets an outside edge. The ball flies just past the diving keeper to his left and races away to the fence.
Akeal Hosein walks out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and Josh Little gets his reward! He serves a very full ball, outside off. Joseph looks to drive but manages to slice it straight to Andy McBrine at extra cover who takes a sharp catch there.
Commentary.Howout: c Andy McBrine b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: A slower ball, on a length, around middle. Smith nudges it to the leg side and takes a run.
SIX! BANG! Full ball, outside off. Odean Smith clears his front leg and smokes it way over the deep extra cover fence for a biggie.
Play and a miss! Good-length ball, outside off. Odean Smith has a wild swing at it but does not get any bat on it.
Back of a length, way outside off. Smith looks to cut but he misses.
Good-length ball, outside off. Alzarri Joseph leaves it alone and Young is denied a hat-trick here! Just 3 runs and 2 wickets off the over!
Alzarri Joseph is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two in two for Craig Young and Ireland have bounced back really well in this contest! Young hurls a full ball, outside off. Holder looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge straight to Andy McBrine at short third man who takes a good catch. Young is on a hat-trick now!
Commentary.Howout: c Andy McBrine b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Odean Smith comes to the crease now.

OUT! TAKEN! Craig Young gets his second wicket and West Indies lose their seventh wicket! A slower ball, into the deck, outside off. Shepherd looks to heave it away but it goes off the top edge, high in the air towards point. Mark Adair settles under it and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, outside off. Shepherd drags it wide of long on. It is that man again, Harry Tector at long on who runs across to his right and dives to stop the ball. The batters take a couple.
Length ball, drifting onto the pads. Holder glances it towards fine leg and collects a run.
Short of a length, outside off. Holder punches it towards the point fielder.
Craig Young (8-0-53-1) is back into the attack.
Length ball, nipping back in from middle. Holder clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Good-length ball, angling in from off. Holder blocks it to the off side. Four dots in a row and this is terrific bowling from Little.
A bit shorter in length, outside off. Jason Holder cuts it towards the backward point fielder.
Full ball, well outside off. Holder fails to reach towards the pitch of the ball.
Short of a length, around off. Jason Holder taps it to backward point.
FOUR! EDGY! Short and wide, outside off. Holder looks to cut but it goes off the thick outside edge towards the third man fence for a boundary.
A fuller length ball, outside off. Romario Shepherd pushes it back to the bowler.
Romario Shepherd is the new man in.

Review time! Shamarh Brooks has been given out LBW and he has reviewed it straightaway! Brooks could be in trouble here! Nothing on the UltraEdge and the Ball Tracker suggests that the ball would have just clipped the middle stump. Brooks will have to take the walk back to the pavilion.

OUT! LBW! Oh, dear! Shamarh Brooks is denied a hundred on his ODI debut by Adair and this is a big wicket for Ireland! This is a back-of-a-length ball, angling in from middle. Brooks stays back and looks to work it to the leg side but he misses and gets rapped on the pads. Mark Adair appeals and the umpire raises his dreaded finger! Brooks opts for a review immediately and the Ball Tracker indicates that the ball would have just clipped the middle stump. It is umpire's call on the wickets and Shamarh Brooks is a goner!
Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks blocks it towards backward point.
Shorter ball, very slow on this occasion, down the leg side. Jason Holder waits back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Much fuller this time, outside off. Jason Holder drives it to cover.

DROPPED! Everything was wrong with that delivery! Mark Adair delivers a low full toss ball, on the pads. Shamarh Brooks goes to heave this over deep mid-wicket but gets a top edge towards Gareth Delany there. Gareth Delany gets in a perfect position and drops an absolute sitter. A single taken.
Mark Adair (7-1-24-1) is into the attack.
Full ball, spraying it on the pads. Shamarh Brooks taps it towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller ball, around the off stump. Jason Holder gets a thick outside edge towards third man for single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Jason Holder dabs it towards point. Dot ball.
Another length ball, on the pads. Jason Holder pushes it towards mid on.
FOUR! Cheeky! A short ball, outside off. Jason Holder waits for it and cuts that very late towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Length ball, on middle. Shamarh Brooks tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Shamarh Brooks, on the back foot, cuts it towards point for a single.
SIX! High and Handsome! A fuller ball, on middle. Shamarh Brooks advances down the track and tonks it high over long on for a biggie.
Shorter ball, around middle, Shamarh Brooks hangs back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter and quicker. Shamarh Brooks prods and blocks it out.
Back of a length, around middle. Jason Holder, on back foot, pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single. Holder is off the mark!
Shorter ball, spinning it onto the middle. Jason Holder pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Pulled away! Craig Young drops it short, around middle. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and slaps it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks taps it towards point. No run there.

OUT! CAUGHT! Craig Young gets the prized wicket of Pollard and this is a huge moment in this game as Pollard could have been dangerous at the fag end. Young bangs it into the deck, outside off. Pollard looks to flat-bat it but it goes off the shoulder off his bat, high in the air towards long on. Harry Tector there, settles under it and takes a good catch. End of a brilliant innings from Pollard and Ireland players would be relieved! West Indies lose their fifth wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Jason Holder walks out to bat.
Wide! Young bangs it into the deck, way above the batter's head. Pollard lets it be and the umpire calls it a wide.

WOW! Harry Tector, you beauty! That's a top save from him at long on, he's been excellent in the field so far! A short ball, outside off. Kieron Pollard makes room and pulls this towards long on. Harry Tector runs towards his right, grabs the ball but crosses the boundary ropes. He does well to keep the ball in play just when he is about to land. Saved a certain six here! The batters take a couple.
A length ball, on the pads. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Stand and deliver! Thank you very much says, Shamarh Brooks! An overpitched delivery, outside off. Shamarh Brooks stands tall and drives it gloriously straight down the ground for a boundary. That brings up the 150 partnership!
Craig Young (6-0-34-0) is back into the attack.
A replica of the previous delivery! On a length, taking the pace off, down the leg side. Kieron Pollard misses his flick again and the ball deflects off his pad and goes to the keeper.
A slower ball this time, on a length, on the pads. Kieron Pollard goes to flick but misses. The ball brushes off his thigh pad and rolls to the keeper.
Another length ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks cuts it towards point and rotates the strike.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Kieron Pollard pushes it towards deep mid-wicket for another single.
A length ball this time, on the pads. Shamarh Brooks tucks it away towards square leg. A single taken.
Josh Little delivers a full ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks leans and drives it towards deep cover for a brace.
Length ball, outside off. Pollard pushes it to the off side.
An off-pace delivery, fuller in length, outside off. Brooks looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Shamarh Brooks cuts it towards point.
Shorter in length, outside off. Pollard drags it towards deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length, way outside off. Shamarh Brooks cuts it past the backward point fielder towards third man for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Pollard steers it towards third man and collects a run.
Little goes fuller this time, outside off. Pollard drills it back past the bowler towards long on for a run. 5 runs off the over!
Back of a length, outsdie off. Pollard looks to cut but it goes off the inside half of the bat towards the keeper, on the bounce.
Short of a length, down leg. Shamarh Brooks clips it behind square on the leg side for one.
On a length, around middle. Pollard nudges it to the leg side and rotates the strike.
Back of a length, around leg. Brooks glances it towards fine leg and collects a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Pollard hangs back and guides it towards third man for a single.
Josh Little (6-1-20-0) is brought back into the attack.
Length ball, outside off. Brooks pushes it to the cover fielder.

SIX! BOOM!  Banged into the deck, outside off. Brooks stays back and pulls it way over the deep square leg fence for a biggie. He has certainly changed gears and looks set to get a big one on debut here!
An overpitched ball, on off. Shamarh Brooks strokes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, around middle. Brooks blocks it out.
SIX! WOW! What a clean strike! This is a full ball, angling in from off. Brooks presents the full face of his bat and sends it sailing way over the long on fence for a biggie.
Good-length ball, on middle. Pollard pushes it towards mid on and takes off for a quick run.
Tossed up, on a length, way outside off. Brooks prods to block it out but he misses and gets hit on his pad. 23 runs off the over!
FOUR! More runs for West Indies! A shorter ball, drifting it onto the pads. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and tucks it away past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
This is a yorker-length ball, around middle. Kieron Pollard digs it out towards the leg side for a single.
SIX! Three maximums in a row for the West Indies skipper! Flatter ball, on a length, around middle and leg. Pollard backs away and pulls it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
SIX! WHACKED! Pollard brings up his fifty in some style! Tosses it up,around off. Pollard smokes it over long on for a biggie. A responsible innings from the Windies' skipper!
SIX! BANG! Flatter and quicker, outside off. Pollard lofts it way over long on for a maximum.
A quicker ball, around middle. Shamarh Brooks clips it towards mid-wicket and comes back for the second run. Fifty on debut for Brooks! A gritty knock from Brooks so far.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Kieron Pollard eases it to long off for a run.
Flatter ball,drifting onto the pads. Brooks tucks it behind square on the leg side for a run.
An overpitched ball, around middle. Pollard drills it to long on for a single.
SIX! Pollard breaks the shackles! This is looped up, on a length, around off. Pollard backs away and sends it sailing over long on to collect a biggie.
Flatter ball, around off. Kieron Pollard presses forward and blocks it out.
Tossing it up this time, around middle. Shamarh Brooks pushes it towards mid-wicket. Dot to end the over.
FOUR! Cleverly done! A fuller loopy ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks lunges, opens the face of his bat, and guides the ball past point for a boundary.
Flatter, on the pads this time. Kieron Pollard pushes it towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller again, outside off. Shamarh Brooks leans and drives it to cover for a single.
Tossed up delivery, on middle. Shamarh Brooks has blocked this one solidly.
Flatter and quicker from Andy McBrine. Kieron Pollard steps down and pushes it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Driven to cover. Dot to end the over.
Shorter this time, angling it onto the pads. Kieron Pollard nudges it towards square leg for another single.
Loopy delivery, much fuller this time, outside off. Shamarh Brooks leans and drives it towards long off and rotates the strike.
Back of a length, outside off. Kieron Pollard slaps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Touch shorter, around the pads. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Swept away! A loopy ball, around middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks gets down on his knee and sweeps it through the inner half of his bat past the diving fielder at square leg for a boundary.
Loopy ball, full in length, around middle and leg. Kieron Pollard leans and tucks it towards deep mid-wicket. Two runs to end the over.
Back of a length, around middle. Shamarh Brooks pushes it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Cut away beautifully! A shorter ball, wide of off. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and chops it through cover for a boundary.
Review time! Ireland review for an LBW! Looks close this time around. Nothing on the UltraEdge and the Ball Tracker indicates that the impact was outside off.

NOT OUT! Ireland lose another review! This was a flatter ball, just outside off and spinning in late. Brooks looks to block off the front foot but he misses and gets hit on his pad. Andy McBrine appeals but the umpire says no. Andy Balbirnie opts for a review but the Ball Tracker suggests that the impact was outside off. Hence, the on-field decision stays and Ireland lose their second review.
Tossed up, around off. Shamarh Brooks defends it out.
Flatter ball, around middle. Kieron Pollard tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
An appeal for LBW, but turned down! An arm-ball fired it onto the pads. Shamarh Brooks misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. That was sliding down leg.
Flatter this time, and quicker. Shamarh Brooks blocks this one to point.
Another floated delivery, around off. Shamarh Brooks defends it out towards cover. No runt there.
Loopy delivery, around off. Shamarh Brooks leans and blocks it towards cover. Another dot ball.
Touch shorter this time, outside off. Shamarh Brooks, on back foot, pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Nicely done! A loopy ball, down the leg side. Shai Hope sweeps it behind the keeper. The ball races away towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
George Dockrell comes to bowl now.
Touch shorter, on middle. Kieron Pollard hangs back and defends it out.
Back of a length around middle. Kieron Pollard taps it towards mid-wicket. Dot ball again.
Much flatter this time, quicker through the air. Kieron Pollard tucks it towards square leg.
Tossed up, very full, around off. Kieron Pollard pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Shortish ball, on the pads. Kieron Pollard blocks it out.

A loopy delivery, turning it in onto the pads. Shamarh Brooks leans and pushes it towards fine leg. Kieron Pollard wants a single and leaves his crease at the other end but is sent back. Lorcan Tucker collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end, but misses the stump. The batters steal an overthrow in return.

An appeal for LBW but the umpire is not interested! Good-length ball, outside off and jagging back in late. Pollard steps out of his crease and looks to block but he misses. The ball hits him high on his pad.
FOUR! A bumper, outside off. Kieron Pollard hangs back and pulls it in front of square to bag a boundary.
Aerial but safe! Full ball, around middle. Brooks looks to whip it but it takes the leading edge and falls short of the deep point fielder. A single taken.
BEATEN! Good-length delivery, outside off. Shamarh Brooks looks to poke at it but the ball zips past his blade.
On a length, around middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Length ball, angling in from middle. Shamarh Brooks glances it through the fine leg region for a boundary.

DRINKS BREAK! Kieron Pollard ​​​​and Shamarh Brooks have done well here. They are trying to rebuild and have got the scoreboard ticking. Ireland have grabbed four quick wickets but are in search of their fifth. They need to break this partnership, if they want to chase down a low score.
Flatter ball, around off. Kieron Pollard presses forward and blocks it off the side.

NOT OUT! Shamarh Brooks SURVIVES! A good review from Ireland nonetheless! This was tossed up, just outside off and turning in late. Shamarh Brooks prods to block but he misses and gets rapped in front. McBrine appeals but the umpire is not interested! Andy Balbirnie opts for a review but the Ball Tracker indicates that the ball would have just clipped the leg stump and it is umpire's call on wickets. A lucky escape for Brooks! Ireland don't lose a review though!

Review-time! Ireland have reviewed an LBW decision! The replay rolls in. UltraEdge confirms there is no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows us that it is umpire's call on wickets! Shamarh Brooks survives and the on-field decision stands!
Flatter ball, shorter in length, outside off and turning in late. Shamarh Brooks misses his nudge on the leg side and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Tossed up, around middle. Kieron Pollard eases it to long on for a run.
An appeal for LBW but the umpire says no! Flatter ball, spinning in from outside off. Pollard misses his flick and gets raoped on the pads. That would have gone down leg.
Flatter ball, angling in from middle. Brooks tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Andy McBrine (2-0-3-2) is back on now!
Good-length ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks steers it towards third man for a single.
Top effort from Tector at point! Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks cuts but Tector does well to stop the ball.
On a length, angling in from off. Brooks pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Banged into the deck, around off. Pollard swivels and pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for a run.
TWO LEG BYES! Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Pollard misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg for a couple of leg byes.
Wide! A slower ball, on a length but sprayed down leg. Pollard lets it be and the umpire calls it as a wide.
Length ball, nipping in from middle. Brooks glances it towards fine leg for a single.
Mark Adair (5-1-11-1) is brought back into the attack.
Short of a length, outside off. Pollard blocks it towards point.
A bit shorter in length, outside off. Brooks punches it to deep cover and collects a run.
On a length, around off. Pollard skips down and eases it to long on for a single.
Wide! Banged into the deck, down leg. Kieron Pollard misses his pull and the umpire calls it a wide. 100 comes up for West Indies!
On a length, around middle. Pollard blocks it out.
FOUR! This time Pollard gets it from the middle of his bat! Back of a length, outside off. Pollard stays back and pulls it through the mid-wicket region for another boundary.
FOUR! A welcome boundary! Full ball, outside off. Kieron Pollard throws his bat at it and the ball goes off the outer half of his blade over the point fielder for a boundary.
A bit fuller this time, around middle. Brooks prods and clips it past the mid-wicket fielder for another couple of runs.
Back of a length, outside off. Brooks punches it through the cover region for a couple of runs.
Good-length ball, around middle. Shamarh Brooks tucks it to square leg and Kieron Pollard yells 'waittt' from the non-striker's end.
Play and a miss! Short of a length, way outside off. Brooks misses his cut shot yet again.
Much better from Campher! This is a good-length ball, outside off. Brooks looke to poke at it but the ball goes past his blade.
Wide! And again! Shorter and wider, outside off. Brooks misses his cut and the umpire calls it a wide.
Wide! Play and a miss! Back of a length, way outside off. Brooks stays back to cut but gets no bat on it. Wided!
Length ball, angling in from outside off. Shamarh Brooks leaves it alone for the keeper to collect it.
Back of a length, outside off. Kieron Pollard steps down the pitch and blocks it towards cover. Dot to end the over.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Kieron Pollard tucks it to mid-wicket. No run there.
Touch fuller darting this one on the pads. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards fine leg. A single taken.
Another shorter one, outside off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it towards cover. No run taken.
Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks defends it out.

FOUR! This time Shamarh Brooks gets lucky! Not the best way to get boundaries, but West Indies will take it! A short ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks looks to chop this towards third man, but get a top-edge over the slip fielder for a boundary!
Craig Young (4-0-18-0) comes back to bowl.
Fuller in length, on middle. Kieron Pollard blocks it out solidly towards mid on. A good over for West Indies!
Wide! Fuller, spraying it down the leg side. Pollard misses his flick. Wide called.
Edgy runs again! A fuller ball, on middle. Kieron Pollard goes for the flick but gets an outside edge through cover. Two runs taken.
A length ball, outside off. Kieron Pollard leaves it alone.

FOUR! Lucky boundary for Pollard but he would not mind that! On a length, around off. Kieron Pollard looks to drive this on the up towards cover but manages to get a thick inside edge past the leg pole. The ball races away towards tthe fine leg fence for a boundary. A boundary after 12 overs for West Indies.
Another good length delivery, outside off. Kieron Pollard pushes it towards cover.
A length ball, outside off. Kieron Pollard lets that go through to the keeper.

A direct hit at the bowler's end but Pollard is well inside his crease! A fuller ball, on middle. Kieron Pollard drives it towards mid on and scampers through to the other end. The fielder at mid on collects the ball and throws it at the non-strikers end. The ball knocks the stumps over but Pollard is home comfortably.
A length ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks taps it towards point and takes a single.
Touch shorter, outside off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it to the man at cover.
Good-length delivery, on the thigh pads. Kieron Pollard taps it towards square leg off the back foot and takes a single.
A length ball, on middle. Kieron Pollard defends it out solidly.
Back of a length, outside off. Pollard leaves it alone.
Another full delivery, on the pads. Kieron Pollard steps down the pitch and pushes it towards square leg for a single. There has been no boundary since the last 10 overs now!
Much fuller on this occasion, around middle. Kieron Pollard tucks it towards mid-wicket. No run taken there.
Shorter ball, outside off. Kieron Pollard steps down the pitch and leaves it alone.
On a good length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it with the outer half of his bat towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks stands tall and punches it towards the diving fielder at extra cover.
Swing and a miss! Good length, wide of off. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and tries to slash this but fails to get to the ball.
Touch shorter, outside off. Kieron Pollard leaves it alone.
Quick single! A length delivery, around off. Shamarh Brooks leans and taps it towards point and scampers through to the other end.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Kieron Pollard, on the back foot, tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Fuller length, around middle. Kieron Pollard drives it to mid on. No run there.
Another good-length ball, around off. Kieron Pollard steps out and defends it out.
Josh Little serves a length ball, nipping back in on middle. Kieron Pollard blocks it out watchfully.
Josh Little (4-1-15-0) is back into the attack.
Back of a length, around off. Brooks hangs back and defends it out solidly.
On a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks shoulders his arms to this one.
Short of a length, well outside off. Kieron Pollard advances down the pitch yet again and blocks. It goes off the outer half of the bat past the diving backward point fielder for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Kieron Pollard skips down the track and blocks it to the off side.

Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and punches it past the cover-point fielder. The fielder there gives it a chase and cuts it off just before the ropes. The batters take three runs.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, outside off and shaping away late. Shamarh Brooks looks to drive on the up but the ball zips past his blade.
Kieron Pollard walks out to bat at number 6.

OUT! TAKEN! Andy McBrine is on a roll and this time it is Roston Chase who has to walk back to the pavilion! McBrine serves a loopy ball, fuller in length, around middle. The ball holds a bit in the surface and spins in sharply. Chase prods and looks to work it to the leg side but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards mid-wicket. Harry Tector there, dives in front and takes a good low catch. West Indies slip further!
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Roston Chase blocks it to the off side.
Flatter ball, drifting onto the pads. Brooks tucks it to the leg side and collects a run.
Loopy ball, outside off. Shamarh Brooks drives hard but straight to the cover fielder.
Flatter ball, on a length, around middle. Brooks presses forward to defend it.
Tossed up, around off. Shamarh Brooks prods and blocks it out.
Short of a length, way outside off. Brooks stays back, rides the bounce well and opens the face of his bat to guide it past the backward point fielder for a single. The debutant is off the mark!
On a length, way outside off. Shamarh Brooks defends it to the off side.
Lovely delivery! Good-length delivery, outside off and curling away late. Brooks looks to poke at it at first but decides to sway away from the line of the ball in the end.
Short of a length, outside off. Roston Chase hangs back and works it behind square on the off side for a single. Chase is up and running!
Back of a length, outside off. Roston Chase leaves it alone.
Roston Chase comes out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Curtis Campher strikes this time and this is turning out be a wonderful passage of play for the tourists! This was a length ball, outside off. Hope stays back and has a tentative poke at it. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards Lorcan Tucker behind the sticks who grabs it with ease. West Indies are in a spot of bother now as both the set batters are back in the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Curtis Campher

Commentary.Commentary: This is an overpitched ball, around middle. Shamarh Brooks tucks it to mid-wicket. A successful over for Ireland!
Shamarh Brooks comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! The ploy to bring on an off-spinner has done wonders for Ireland as they get the big wicket of Nicholas Pooran! McBrine serves it fuller, around off. Pooran looks to go over long on but it goes off the inside half of the blade, in the air towards William Porterfield at long on who makes no mistake. West Indies lose their second wicket and the Irish players are delighted!
Commentary.Howout: c William Porterfield b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: Drags his length back a bit, around middle. Pooran keeps it out.
Loopy ball, outside off. Shai Hope prods and carves it wide of long off for a run.
Uppish but safe! Tossed up nicely, outside off. Pooran looks to go downtown but it goes off the toe end towards the long off fielder, on the bounce. A single taken!
McBrine starts with a flatter ball, on off. Nicholas Pooran blocks it out watchfully.
Andy McBrine comes into the attack.
Back of a length, around off. Shai Hope stays back and blocks it to the off side. Good over from Campher!
On a length, angling acrosss the right-hander. Hope shoulders his arms to this one. There is still some movement for the Irish bowlers here.
Short and wide, outside off. Hope hangs back and cuts it straight towards backward point.
Length ball, nipping back in from middle. Hope turns it to mid-wicket.
A bumper, around off. Hope rides the bounce nicely and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Banged into the deck, outside off. Hope stays back and pulls it along the ground towards mid-wicket.

DRINKS BREAK!  West Indies have done well to negotiate the new ball as there was movement early on for the Irish bowlers. Shai Hope and Nicholas Pooran have steadied the ship nicely after losing Justin Greaves in the sixth over. The Irish bowlers will now look to chip in with wickets and put some pressure on the hosts.
Another length delivery, angling across off. Nicholas Pooran leaves it alone.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Nicholas Pooran swings his bat and looks to drive this towards cover, but fails to get any bat on it.
Touch fuller, outside off this time. Nicholas Pooran leans and blocks it towards cover.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Shai Hope clips it to square leg for another single.
A length ball, on the pads. Nicholas Pooran tucks it towards square leg. A single taken.

A direct hit could have been close here! A length ball, outside off. Shai Hope taps it towards backward point and scampers through to the other end. Harry Tector runs forward, dives and collects the ball and throws it immediately at the striker's end but misses.
WIDE! Too short and wide of off. Shai Hope leaves it alone. Wide called by the umpire. Craig Young has not quite hit the radar yet.
Much fuller this time, outside off. Nicholas Pooran drives it to cover. Dot ball to end the over.
A length ball, outside off. Nicholas Pooran leaves it alone.
Back-of-a-length delivery, on middle. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and pulls it to the man at mid-wicket.
Touch shorter, around the off stump. Nicholas Pooran looks to push this away towards the off side but gets an inside edge near the off pole.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Nicholas Pooran leans and blocks it out.
Length ball, on off, it stays low this time. Shai Hope blocks it watchfully towards point and takes a quick single.
Tad fuller, drifting it on the pads. Shai Hope flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. He will keep the strike for the next over.
A length ball, nipping back in on off. Shai Hope pushes it to the man at cover.
Craig Young drops it short, around middle. Shai Hope goes for the pull but fails to get any connection on that.
LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads. Nicholas Pooran misses his flick and the ball deflects off the front pad and rolls towards fine leg. The batters steal a leg bye.
On a length, around the fourth stump line. Nicholas Pooran guides it towards point. Another dot ball.
Full in length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran blocks it towards cover off the front foot. No run there.
Curtis Campher goes full again, outside off. Nicholas Pooran prods and taps it towards cover and scampers through to the other end for a quick single.
FOUR! A half volley by Curtis Campher and Pooran makes full use of it! An overpitched delivery, outside off. Nicholas Pooran lunges and drives it beautifully through the cover region for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Pooran leaves it alone.
On a length, around off. Nicholas Pooran covers the line and blocks it solidly.
Fuller length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran leans and drives it to the man at cover.
Swing and a miss! Much shorter this time, wide of off. Nicholas Pooran, on the back foot, looks to cut this away, but fails to get any bat on it.
WIDE! Curtis Campher starts off with a length ball, down the leg side. Nicholas Pooran goes for the flick and misses. The umpire calls it a wide.
Curtis Campher comes into the attack now.
FOUR! Nicely done! Young drops this one short, around middle and off. Shai Hope hangs back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Hope ends the over with a four.
Fuller in length, outside off. Shai Hope leans and drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Length delivery, on the pads. Nicholas Pooran, on the back foot, taps it towards square leg. A single taken.
Much fuller this time, on middle. Shai Hope drags it wide of mid on and takes a quick single.
BEATEN! Good-length delivery, outside off. Shai Hope tries to block it but gets beaten past the outside edge as the ball shapes away a tad.
A length delivery, outside off. Shai Hope lets that go through to the keeper.
Good-length delivery, around off and curling away a bit. Pooran stays back and blocks it to cover. Just one run off the over! West Indies are 36/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
On a length, around the fifth stump channel. Shai Hope prods, opens the face of his bat and steers it to third man for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Shai Hope gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Adair serves a length ball, just outside off. Shai Hope blocks it out solidly.
On a length, outside off. Hope shoulders his arms to this one.
Fuller in length, outside off. Hope looks to drive on the up but the ball whistles past his blade.
BEATEN! Length ball, outside off and nipping back in late. Nicholas Pooran looks to drive but the ball sneaks through his bat towards the keeper.
Wide! Another ball, down leg. Nicholas Pooran misses his heave and the umpire stretches his arms yet again to signal a wide.
Top delivery! Good-length ball, around off and shaping away late. Pooran looks to block but gets squared up as the ball zips past his outside edge.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for West Indies! Fuller in length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran drills it back past the bowler and collects a boundary.
Wide! Back of a length, down leg. Pooran misses his heave on the leg side and the umpire signals it as a wide.

Review-time! Ireland have reviewed an LBW decision. The replay rolls in. UltraEdge confirms no bat involved. Ball Tracker indicates it was pitching outside leg. The original decision stands and Ireland lose a review.

NOT OUT! Another loud shout for LBW but the umpire says no! Length ball, around leg and going on with the angle. Nicholas Pooran prods to block but he misses and gets rapped on the pads. Andy Balbirnie opts for a review but the Ball Tracker indicates that the ball was pitched outside leg so the on-field decision stays and Ireland lose a review here!
A bit shorter this time, outside off. Shai Hope stays back and steers it towards third man for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Shai Hope leaves it alone.
Craig Young comes into the attack now.
BEATEN! Short of a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran looks to cut but he fails to get any bat on it.
Adair hurls a length delivery, around off. Nicholas Pooran presses forward to block it.
Length ball, way outside off. Pooran lets it through to the keeper.

Leg bye! A loud shout for LBW but the umpire is unmoved! Length ball, jagging back in from middle. Hope looks to nudge it to the leg side but he misses. He gets hit low on his pad and the ball rolls away to the off side for a leg bye.
On a length, outside off. Shai Hope taps it to the off side.
A stifled appeal for caught behind but the umpire says no! Back of a length, angling down leg. Shai Hope misses his flick and the ball clips his pad before going to the keeper.
Back of a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran taps it towards backward point. 9 runs off the over!
Good running! Length ball, around middle. Shai Hope tucks it towards square leg and takes off for a quick single.
Fuller in length, way outside off. Shai Hope leaves it alone.
Touch fuller, on off. Nicholas Pooran taps it towards point and scampers through to the other end.
Josh Little drops it short this time, on the body. Shai Hope hangs back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Three runs taken.

FOUR! EDGY BOUNDARY! A little bit of luck here for Shai Hope. Josh Little serves a length ball, around the off pole. Shai Hope looks to push this towards cover, but gets a thick inside edge past the leg stump. The ball races away towards the fine leg fence for a four.
A length ball, shaping it away from the left-hander. Nicholas Pooran leaves it alone. End of a successful over by Mark Adair.

OUT! TAKEN! A top effort from Gareth Delany at mid-wicket and Ireland get the breakthrough! This was a full ball, nipping back in from middle. Greaves looks to flick it uppishly but finds Gareth Delany at mid-wicket who dives in front and takes a good low catch. However, the umpires decide to take it upstairs and the TV umpire says that there is no conclusive evidence to change the soft signal. Justin Greaves, the debutant walks back to the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c Gareth Delany b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Nicholas Pooran walks out to bat at number 3.

Is that a clean catch? Gareth Delany dives in front at mid-wicket to take the catch. The umpires decide to send it upstairs. The soft signal is out! The replays roll in and the TV umpire says that he does not have any conclusive evidence to overturn the decision. Hence, the on-field decision remains.
Wide! Adair errs in line and sprays it down leg. Justin Greaves looks to flick but he misses and the umpire signals it as a wide.
This is a short-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Justin Greaves rides the bounce well and taps it to backward point.
Length ball, jagging back in from middle. Justin Greaves misses his flick and the ball brushes his pad before going to the keeper.
Play and a miss! Back of a length, outside off. Justin Greaves stays back to cut but the misses out.
Leg bye! Length ball, angling in from middle. Shai Hope misses his flick and gets hit on his pad. The ball rolls away to the left of the keeper for a leg bye.
Back of a length, outside off. Justin Greaves, on back foot, pushes it towards cover. Dot to end the over.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, shaping it away outside off. Justin Greaves looks to chops it away but fails to get any bat on it.

An appeal for LBW, but the umpire is unmoved! A fuller ball, nipping back in onto the pads. Justin Greaves misses his flick and gets rapped on the front pad. An appeal for LBW but the umpire says no, that was probably going down leg.
Touch shorter again, outside off. Justin Greaves looks to have a poke at it but gets beaten as the ball zips past the outside edge.
Back-of-a-length delivery, on the hips. Justin Greaves nudges it towards square leg.
A full-length ball, on middle. Shai Hope pushes it uppishly towards mid on for a single.
Good-length delivery, around the off pole. Justin Greaves gets an inside edge towards deep square leg for a brace. A productive over here for West Indies.
FOUR! Top-shot! Another fuller ball, on middle and leg. Justin Greaves uses his wrists and flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
An appeal for LBW but turned down! A fuller ball, on the pads. Justin Greaves goes for the flick but gets a slight inside edge onto his pad.
BEATEN! What a peach of a delivery by Mark Adair! A length ball, outside off. Justin Greaves looks to defend that but gets beaten as the ball shapes away from him a tad.
Touch shorter this time, outside off. Justin Greaves gets on top of that and blocks it towards cover.
Mark Adair overpitches this one, on middle. Justin Greaves pushes it towards mid on.
LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads. Justin Greaves misses his flick and the ball deflects off his pad and rolls towards fine leg. The batters steal a leg bye.
Josh Little drops it short this time, on the body. Justin Greaves looks to pull this one, but fails to connect it.
Good-length delivery, angling across off. Justin Greaves taps it towards point.
Josh Little serves a length ball, on the pads. Justin Greaves looks to flick this but gets an outside edge towards point. No run taken.
Back of a length, outside off. Justin Greaves pushes it towards the fielder at cover. Another dot ball.
Shorter length, around the fifth stump line. Justin Greaves offers no shot on that.
A length ball, nipping back in on middle. Shai Hope gets an inside edge onto his thigh pad. Dot to end the over.
On a length, drifting it onto the pads. Shai Hope pushes it towards mid-wicket. No run there.
Back of a length, outside off. Shai Hope blocks it towards cover off the back foot.

Another inswinger, much fuller this time, outside off. Justin Greaves opens the face of his bat and guides it towards point. The fielder there dives to his left and makes a good stop. A single taken. Justin Greaves gets off the mark with that!
Good-length delivery, shaping it onto the pads. Shai Hope tucks it towards square leg and takes a single.
WIDE! A length ball, wide of off. Shai Hope leaves that alone. Wide called by the umpire.
Mark Adair starts off with a full-length delivery, outside off. Shai Hope lunges and blocks it out solidly.
Who will bowl from the other end? Mark Adair it is.
A length ball, outside off. Justin Greaves lets that go through to the keeper. 5 runs off the first over!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Justin Greaves shoulders arms to it.
Touch shorter this time, outside off. Shai Hope, on the back foot, taps it to cover and scampers through to the other end.
FOUR! Shai Hope and West Indies are underway in style! A full-pitched delivery, on off. Shai Hope punches it down the ground for a glorious drive.
Another length delivery, outside off. Shai Hope looks to defend but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Josh Little begins with a length ball, outside off, slight away movement for Little. Shai Hope leaves it alone.

We are set for the game to begin! The players of Ireland stride out to the middle. Shai Hope and Justin Greaves, the debutant, walk out to bat for West Indies. Josh Little to start with the ball. Here we go...

Kieron Pollard, the skipper of West Indies says that they have to bat first and bat well to set a good target. Mentions that he has been looking after himself and the break after the World Cup has helped him, and he is looking forward to this series. Adds that the team showed great enthusiasm against Pakistan, the results didn't go as planned but the team did well. Concludes that they have given a few youngsters the opportunity in this game.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says that they will bowl first. Adds that it is an early morning start and there will be something in the pitch for the bowlers. Tells that Josh Little has been in some fine form so watch out for him. Mentions that West Indies has some good bowlers and he enjoys facing best of bowlers.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope, Justin Greaves (On Debut), Nicholas Pooran (WK), Shamarh Brooks (On Debut), Kieron Pollard (C), Roston Chase, Jason Holder, Romario Shepherd, Odean Smith (On Debut), Alzarri Joseph, Akeal Hosein.
Ireland (Playing XI) - William Porterfield, Andy Balbirnie (C), Andy McBrine, Harry Tector, Gareth Delany, Curtis Campher, Lorcan Tucker (WK), George Dockrell, Mark Adair, Craig Young, Josh Little.
TOSS UPDATE - Ireland have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

BREAKING NEWS - Simi Singh and Benjamin White are ruled out of the first ODI as they have tested positive for Covid. However, all the other Irish players, coaches and support staff members have returned with negative results. Hence, the game will go ahead as per the schedule.

Ireland, on the other hand, last played an ODI series in September 2021 against Zimbabwe and their historic ODI series against USA was cancelled due to Covid-19. Andy Balbirnie will be leading the Irish side and the tourists have some good blend of youth and experience in their squad. Ireland have got the better of West Indies just once in ODIs and they will be keen to better their record against the Windies at Jamaica. Will this Irish side start off on a winning note and stun the Windies? We shall find that soon. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.

West Indies last played an ODI series against Australia at home which they lost and they would be looking to make amends against Ireland in this series. They are led by Kieron Pollard and have some quality international players in their lineup as well. The likes of Nicholas Pooran, Roston Chase and Jason Holder will need to put their best foot forward and their experience will come in handy for the hosts. Pollard and his men would be eager to draw first blood which will set the tone for the rest of the series.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the coverage of the first ODI of the three-match series between West Indies and Ireland. Both these sides will be back to the international arena after Covid-induced breaks and they would be itching to take the field. We hope that the virus stays away from this series and we get to witness an entire series which is well-fought.
...Match Day...
